ideas.pitch: A graph intelligence platform mapping local DFW freight corridors to detect anomalies in supply chain logistics and predict delivery bottlenecks using LightGBM and spatial data.
ideas.title: DFW Supply Chain Guardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting local enterprise infrastructure makes sense for a large regional hackathon in Texas, leveraging hard ML engineering similar to past winners.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent marketplace matching student commuter demand with autonomous or volunteer student drivers on campus, complete with escrow payments and route optimization.
ideas.title: Campus Shuttle Autonomous Dispatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges and students feel themselves every day on a sprawling university campus, while adopting a proven autonomous marketplace architecture.

ideas.pitch: A Poisson regression and GAM-based forecasting dashboard predicting ERCOT energy pricing spikes and grid incidents with calibrated prediction intervals.
ideas.title: Texas Grid Load Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive regional pain point in Texas regarding power grid stability, using rigorous predictive modeling seen in winning technical projects.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition assistant integrated with campus dining hall menus to deliver personalized meal plans and micro-nutrient tracking for student athletes and busy hackers.
ideas.title: Student Health and Nutrition Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets student wellness directly, building an immediately demonstrable consumer utility that resonated well in past health-tech hackathon tracks.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent routing platform that matches hacker project queries with the exact available mentors or sponsors who have the matching niche technical expertise in real time.
ideas.title: HackUTD Mentor Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a meta-problem directly experienced by event organizers and participants during a 47-hour in-person hackathon.
